files.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml b/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml
index 121f3ee..5dc6ec4 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml
@@ -1,88 +1,122 @@
 name: Publish Live Remediation PR State
 
 on:
   pull_request:
     types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, closed]
   workflow_dispatch:
 
 permissions:
   contents: write
+  pull-requests: read
   pages: write
   id-token: write
 
 concurrency:
   group: pages
   cancel-in-progress: false
 
 jobs:
   publish-pr-state:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - name: Checkout main
         uses: actions/checkout@v4
         with:
           ref: main
           fetch-depth: 1
 
       - name: Publish remediation PR metadata
         env:
           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
           REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           mkdir -p data
-          curl --fail --silent --show-error             -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json"             -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}"             -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28"             "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=all&per_page=30&sort=updated&direction=desc"             | jq '[.[] | select(.head.ref | startswith("security-remediation/")) | {
-                number,
-                title,
-                state,
-                merged: (.merged_at != null),
-                head: .head.ref,
-                base: .base.ref,
-                url: .html_url,
-                created_at,
-                updated_at,
-                merged_at
-              }]' > data/pull-requests.json
-          python3 -m json.tool data/pull-requests.json >/dev/null
-          cat data/pull-requests.json
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json, os, urllib.request
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          repo = os.environ["REPOSITORY"]
+          token = os.environ["GH_TOKEN"]
+          req = urllib.request.Request(
+              f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/pulls?state=all&per_page=30&sort=updated&direction=desc",
+              headers={
+                  "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
+                  "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
+                  "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
+              },
+          )
+          with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
+              prs = json.load(response)
+
+          remediation_prs = []
+          for pr in prs:
+              head = pr.get("head", {}).get("ref", "")
+              if not head.startswith("security-remediation/"):
+                  continue
+              remediation_prs.append({
+                  "number": pr.get("number"),
+                  "title": pr.get("title"),
+                  "state": pr.get("state"),
+                  "merged": pr.get("merged_at") is not None,
+                  "head": head,
+                  "base": pr.get("base", {}).get("ref"),
+                  "url": pr.get("html_url"),
+                  "created_at": pr.get("created_at"),
+                  "updated_at": pr.get("updated_at"),
+                  "merged_at": pr.get("merged_at"),
+              })
+
+          Path("data/pull-requests.json").write_text(
+              json.dumps(remediation_prs, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
+          )
+
+          latest_path = Path("data/latest.json")
+          latest = json.loads(latest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+          latest["pull_requests"] = remediation_prs
+          latest_path.write_text(
+              json.dumps(latest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
+          )
+          print(json.dumps(remediation_prs, indent=2))
+          PY
 
       - name: Commit live PR state
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
           git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
-          git add data/pull-requests.json
+          git add data/pull-requests.json data/latest.json
           if git diff --cached --quiet; then
             echo "No PR state changes."
             exit 0
           fi
           git commit -m "chore: publish live remediation PR state [skip ci]"
           git push origin HEAD:main
 
       - name: Build isolated Pages site
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           rm -rf .pages
           mkdir -p .pages/data/scans
           cp index.html .pages/index.html
           cp data/latest.json .pages/data/latest.json
           cp data/index.json .pages/data/index.json
           cp data/pull-requests.json .pages/data/pull-requests.json
           cp -R data/scans/. .pages/data/scans/
           cat > .pages/deployment.json <<EOF
           {
             "deployed_at": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
             "workflow_run": "${{ github.run_id }}"
           }
           EOF
 
       - name: Configure GitHub Pages
         uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
 
       - name: Upload Pages artifact
         uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
         with:
           path: .pages
 
       - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
         uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
